GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: Gran Turismo 7 players who read the app at a glance while racing, often on a second screen at arm's length.
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: Dark-only, game-styled presentation: pure black background, near-black panels (#16191E / #16191E at 80%), 1 px hairline borders (0x24FFFFFF), radii 7/8/12 and the 5-7-8-9-10-12 spacing scale taken from DESIGN.md.
Numbers that update live use tabular figures so digits do not jitter; telemetry text uses the gt7Caption/gt7Digital helpers, and every gauge is a custom painter already in lib/widgets/telemetry.

Async surfaces always answer three questions: loading (spinner or Skeletonizer), empty (SizedBox.shrink or a panel with a reason), error (inline panel tinted with colorScheme.error plus a refresh IconButton).
Refresh is an explicit IconButton; pull-to-refresh is not used anywhere in the app.
Layout must survive phone-to-desktop widths: LayoutBuilder with the 600/800/900/1200 breakpoints, and no Card/ListTile/elevation-based surfaces.
Respect the system UI: screens keep Scaffold chrome disabled (extendBody, translucent app bar) and use SafeArea so content scrolls under the bottom navigation.
